localChanges: chore: lock the engine packages that let units on GoTo stop to ask on arrival and fly around rival cities

log: moveAlongPath no longer takes the last step when the destination offers an action that isn't a Move, or is a CaptureCity (help build a Wonder, a Diplomat's actions, an attack, capturing a city). It ends the journey one tile short with the unit awake and processes the new Halted rule with the destination, so a client can offer the choice (civ-clone/web-renderer#357).
GoTo.perform only marks the unit GoTo-busy while its journey is still under way: a journey ended on the first leg (blocked, arrived or halted) used to leave the unit awake but still showing GoTo.
The turn-start continuation now passes the Game's rule and strategy note registries through to moveAlongPath.
chore: drop the stale package-lock.json and fail CI when the committed .js is stale (civ-clone/web-renderer#66)

Covers civ-clone/web-renderer#281: Forest+Game clears to Plains+Horse, Swamp+Oil / Jungle+Gems / Plains+Horse plant to Forest+Game, and Grassland's Shield or no special leaves none. Needs base-unit-action-clear-forest and base-unit-action-plant-forest published with the fix.
test: a planted Forest no longer rolls for Game (civ-clone/web-renderer#281)
civ1-unit:unit/halted/emit tells the engine, as moved/emit does, so the human client can offer the choice (civ-clone/web-renderer#357). Needs base-unit-action-goto 0.1.8 for the Halted rule.
fix: declare base-unit-action-goto as a dependency, as Rules/Unit/halted imports it at runtime

A tile holding another player's unit or city is impassable except as the destination. A route through one stopped there, because there is no Move onto it: an aircraft sent home past a rival city stopped short and crashed (civ-clone/web-renderer#357). core-city moves to dependencies for CityRegistry.
chore: fail CI when the committed .js is stale, as the other engine repos do (civ-clone/web-renderer#66)
test: an aircraft routes around another player's city
